what: Mika in her Fox-Flame Sword Guard form, a young fox-girl heroine drawn with EXACTLY the proportions of Image 1 (her head, ear tips to chin, is about 30% of her full height, eyes at about 77% of her height above her soles, torso, legs and boots exactly as long as in Image 1; never a bigger head, never shorter legs, never chibier): big orange fox ears with cream inner fur, long red-orange hair with a braid, a red ribbon and a gold flower ornament in her hair, amber eyes, the face of Image 1, a red scarf, ornate black and gold plate armour with red accents, long red cape tails with gold flame patterns flowing behind her, a red tabard skirt with a gold flame crest, black and gold armoured boots, ONE big fluffy orange fox tail with a cream-white tip behind her on the LEFT side of the image, a big broad greatsword with a wide silver blade and a gold crossguard set with a red jewel; crisp clean lines and a sharp face
pose: Her combat guard, exactly Image 1: feet planted apart, the big greatsword held diagonally in front of her in both gauntleted hands, blade pointing up and to the right, calm confident face, her ONE big fox tail behind her on the left, the red cape tails flowing back.
idle: a proud, steady idle in exactly the guard of Image 1: her body, face, hands, greatsword and boots stay still; her ONE big fox tail stays behind her on the LEFT in every frame (it never crosses to the other side and never jumps) and sways in a slow smooth S-curve, the tip lifting a little more each frame (frames 1-4) and lowering back (frames 5-8); her braid and red cape tails ripple gently. Her head, face, both eyes and both fox ears stay exactly the same in every frame (no blinking, no change of expression, no tilt).
fidgets: from her guard she lets go with her left hand (frame 2), swings the greatsword up with her right hand and rests the broad blade on her right shoulder, the blade pointing back behind her, her left hand on her hip, with a relaxed grin (frames 3-5, held), then swings it back down and takes it in both hands again in exactly the guard of Image 1 (frames 6-8). Her legs and feet stay planted, and she stays exactly the size of Image 1 in every frame.

holding the greatsword in her right hand in the guard, she lifts her left hand near her face with the index finger pointing up (frame 2), purses her lips and blows softly on her fingertip (frame 3), a small round orange fox-fire flame (kitsunebi) pops alight on her fingertip (frame 4) and she smiles at it as it flickers (frame 5), then she closes her hand around it and the flame is gone (frame 6) as her left hand returns to the hilt (frames 7-8, exactly the guard of Image 1). Her legs, body and tail stay in place, and she stays exactly the size of Image 1. All flames are clean opaque painted shapes with crisp edges, never smoke, glow haze or loose sparks. Keep every part inside its cell with margin.
entrance: her fox-fire summoning, everything drawn SMALL enough to stay well inside each cell: the flames never rise higher than the tip of her ears in Image 1 and never spread wider than her cape. Frame 1: no character yet, only a small ring of orange fox-fire flames burning on the ground where she will stand. Frame 2: her big greatsword falls from above and stabs point-first into the centre of the flame ring. Frame 3: flames spiral up around the planted sword into a whirling flame column as tall as she is. Frame 4: the flame column takes the shape of a sitting fox made of orange fire, its two ears pointed up, wrapped around the sword. Frame 5: the flame fox splits open down the middle into two tall flame halves hugging her sides closely (no wider than her cape), and she appears between them gripping the planted sword's hilt with both hands. Frame 6: she pulls the sword from the ground and raises it into her guard, the two flame halves shrunk to knee-high flames at her sides. Frame 7: only a few small flames left at her boots. Frame 8: exactly the resting pose of Image 1, no flames. All flames are clean opaque painted shapes with crisp edges, never smoke, glow haze or loose sparks. Every frame keeps a clear empty margin of at least one sixth of the cell on the left and right.
note: showcase/master.png is the combat idle's own drawing (source/raw-master-v2.png through generate2dsprite process, cell 512, fit .86, feet aligned), so the hub shows her with the combat idle's proportions and face; make_showcase.py only draws the loop, the fidgets and the entrance from it.
